partial_history_account.words: On the per-account dashboard, when the served series history_scope is not FULL, one note under the headline reads: this history covers only part of the account's life; earlier days are not included yet. The report path (headline, chart, accounts table) has no history member in its wire contract, so it prints no such sentence.

evidence.text: This history covers only part of the account's life; earlier days are not included yet.

day_not_measured.words: On the dashboard every window day whose day_quality is not MEASURED is counted, and one note per state prints the count with its sentence (NOT_MEASURABLE, FLOW_UNRECONCILED, SOURCE_LAG, LARGE_FLOW); the chart tooltip repeats the sentence for the hovered day. A window whose status is BREAK says a day has no return in place of its figure. The report path carries no day-level flag and prints none.

evidence.text: No return can be measured for this day, so the history has a gap here.
A day in this window has no return, and a return is never linked across a missing day.

fallback_day.words: No fallback state reaches the page. PRD addendum v0.4 ruling 17 withdrew the price-plus-income substitution; the account-return contract return_basis enum is TWR and NOT_MEASURABLE only; DashboardPerformance says there is no fallback footnote. A day the guard could not reconcile is FLOW_UNRECONCILED with no return, which the page explains as a no-return day, not as a fallback. The FWD-10 ACCEPT and the C-HONESTY row still name a fallback footnote, so that clause is stale.

evidence.text: ruling 17 withdrew the fallback, so there is no fallback footnote
NOT_MEASURABLE: 'No return is shown for this day.'

window_before_news_data.words: The on-screen tab carries no news or market-history state: ReportingTab.tsx reads no narrative packet, and no topic-cloud view exists in this tree. The sentence for a window before news history, Market history is not available before a date, prints only on the print and export document, and only when a narrative packet is present and includeNarrative is set. The account-history start IS explained on screen (window opens before the first data date; the window is shortened to start there), but that is a different state from news history.

evidence.text: Market history is not available before
the window was shortened to start there

label.words: Replaced everywhere the new figures show by 'Total return, before advisory fees' with the method version in the popover.

FULL.words: The contract names FULL; coverageWords.ts:31 maps it to a sentence, but DashboardPerformance.tsx:147 prints a history note only when history_scope is not FULL, so no FULL sentence appears on screen.

PARTIAL_HISTORY.words: The dashboard prints coverageWords.ts:32 as a note under the headline when history_scope is not FULL.

NO_LOTS.words: No page code reads a lot axis: coverageWords.ts has no lot member and no portal file names NO_LOTS, so a lot-less account shows no sentence.

FLOW_UNRECONCILED.words: Per window day, a count note prints coverageWords.ts:37; the chart tooltip repeats it (DashboardPerformance.tsx:160).

UNCLASSIFIED_HOLDINGS.words: account_dim coverage never reaches the page: no portal file reads account_dim; the dashboard reads history_scope and day_quality from the series document only.

SOURCE_LAG.words: Carried as a day_quality value, not an account coverage value; a window day with SOURCE_LAG prints the coverageWords.ts:40 sentence through the count note.

FEE_RAIL_UNUSED.words: coverageWords.ts:54 maps it, but the fee_amount_reason axis is never called; the on-screen title 'Total return, before advisory fees' (DashboardPerformance.tsx:53) carries the fact instead.

MISSING_HISTORY.words: Narrative-only (topics). The sentence prints on the print and export document only, when a narrative packet is present and includeNarrative is set (PerformanceDocument.tsx:198); the on-screen tab never shows it.

cottonwood_specific.words: cottonwood_account_dim.py assigns coverage FULL, UNCLASSIFIED_HOLDINGS or PARTIAL_HISTORY per account. cottonwood_report_reader.py assigns no coverage value. The account_dim value reaches no page; the Cottonwood history flag the page reads comes from the account return series (cottonwood_bd_account_return_daily.py:372).
